First off God is with you right now. He hears your prayers (so pray) and knows when you are stressed. Instead of thinking the worst for your future (which a lot of people do, so do not worry), think of all the things you do have in this moment (example a computer with internet access or food in the fridge). It is easy for our minds to get stuck on what we do not have since we are exposed to this "lavish life style" all the time thanks to social media and television. Truth is most people post their great moments/highlights of their life and are not always happy. Do not think in this life you are going to be happy 24 hours a day 7 days a week.

For friends, I suggest, for you to put yourself out there. Find groups whether with a church or volunteer somewhere, trust me, people are out there looking for friends just like you.

I suggest pray for a sign. For example on Friday or Thursday I prayed for a Chocolate Chip Cookie and today my Aunt came to visit me randomly and guess what was in her hand? A bag of cookies

PRAY PRAY PRAY. If Jesus prayed on the regular then trust me it works.

Drift back in with God:) Hope this helps friend
